question: How should the preferences of younger investors shape Edward Jones's offerings?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Schwab serves younger investors through the Schwab Starter Kit and Schwab Teen Investor Account, and offers no/low commissions.
items.quote: Younger investors | Schwab Starter Kit TM | Schwab Teen Investor TM Account | No / low commissions

items.text: Schwab meets younger investors in the channels where they turn for information about investing, noting they learn about finances primarily through social media and family, and that their top online resource is YouTube, where Schwab is the number one financial services firm by followers.
items.quote: One of the reasons they're turning to Schwab is because we're meeting them in the channels where they turn for information about investing. We know they learn about finances primarily through social media and family.

items.text: Schwab offers the thinkorswim trading platform and digital capabilities, with 42% of thinkorswim users being Millennial or Gen Z.
items.quote: 42% of thinkorswim→ users are Millennial or Gen Z 1

items.text: Schwab provides 35 hours a week of live content, plus education, coaching, service and expertise to help young investors learn to trade and invest.
items.quote: We put on 35 hours a week of live content for our investors about how to learn how to trade, how to learn how to invest, the power of things like compounding.
items.unit: hours per week of live content

items.text: Schwab offers in-person experiences in over 400 locations and has 16,000 advisors in every community that young investors can walk in and talk to, positioned as the best place for young investors considering things like paying off college debt or buying a house.
items.quote: We have in-person experiences in over 400 locations across our country. We have 16,000 advisors in every community that you can walk in and talk to.

items.text: Schwab's strategy for younger investors includes supporting growth in young investors through the removal of commissions and anticipation that crypto will be additive and appeal to young investors.
items.quote: We've really seen a growth in young investors, I think part of that was started with the removal of commissions, which brought more people into the market that had less money.

cells.reason: Passages describe Schwab's own offerings and strategies to serve younger investors (Starter Kit, Teen Investor Account, no/low commissions, social media/YouTube presence, thinkorswim, live education content, physical locations, commission removal, crypto).
